acceptance_criteria.title: Acceptance for Customer Completes Onboarding - 1
acceptance_criteria.description: The system shall make available an onboarding journey to a customer.
acceptance_criteria.acceptance_condition: The system shall demonstrate: The system shall make available an onboarding journey to a customer.

acceptance_criteria.title: Acceptance for Customer Completes Onboarding - 2
acceptance_criteria.description: The system shall accept the information required for onboarding.
acceptance_criteria.acceptance_condition: The system shall demonstrate: The system shall accept the information required for onboarding.

acceptance_criteria.title: Acceptance for Customer Completes Onboarding - 3
acceptance_criteria.description: The system shall allow the customer to complete the onboarding journey.
acceptance_criteria.acceptance_condition: The system shall demonstrate: The system shall allow the customer to complete the onboarding journey.

acceptance_criteria.title: Acceptance for Customer Provides KYC Information - 1
acceptance_criteria.description: The system shall accept KYC information from the customer.
acceptance_criteria.acceptance_condition: The system shall demonstrate: The system shall accept KYC information from the customer.

acceptance_criteria.title: Acceptance for Customer Provides KYC Information - 2
acceptance_criteria.description: KYC information is captured for the simulation; it is not verified against any real authority.
acceptance_criteria.acceptance_condition: The system shall demonstrate: KYC information is captured for the simulation; it is not verified against any real authority.

acceptance_criteria.title: Acceptance for Customer Provides Aadhaar and PAN Information - 1
acceptance_criteria.description: The system shall accept Aadhaar and PAN information from the customer.
acceptance_criteria.acceptance_condition: The system shall demonstrate: The system shall accept Aadhaar and PAN information from the customer.

acceptance_criteria.title: Acceptance for Customer Provides Aadhaar and PAN Information - 2
acceptance_criteria.description: Aadhaar/PAN verification performed by the system, if any, shall be format-only and mocked.
acceptance_criteria.acceptance_condition: The system shall demonstrate: Aadhaar/PAN verification performed by the system, if any, shall be format-only and mocked.

acceptance_criteria.title: Acceptance for Customer Provides Aadhaar and PAN Information - 3
acceptance_criteria.description: The system shall not perform real identity verification against any external authority.
acceptance_criteria.acceptance_condition: The system shall demonstrate: The system shall not perform real identity verification against any external authority.

acceptance_criteria.title: Acceptance for Customer Activates an Account - 1
acceptance_criteria.description: The system shall allow a customer account to be activated.
acceptance_criteria.acceptance_condition: The system shall demonstrate: The system shall allow a customer account to be activated.

acceptance_criteria.title: Acceptance for Customer Activates an Account - 2
acceptance_criteria.description: Account activation shall result in an account state that reflects the activation.
acceptance_criteria.acceptance_condition: The system shall demonstrate: Account activation shall result in an account state that reflects the activation.

acceptance_criteria.title: Acceptance for Customer Login - 1
acceptance_criteria.description: The system shall allow a customer to log in.
acceptance_criteria.acceptance_condition: The system shall demonstrate: The system shall allow a customer to log in.

acceptance_criteria.title: Acceptance for Customer Login - 2
acceptance_criteria.description: Login shall provide the customer access consistent with role-based access requirements (see FR-019).
acceptance_criteria.acceptance_condition: The system shall demonstrate: Login shall provide the customer access consistent with role-based access requirements (see FR-019).

acceptance_criteria.title: Acceptance for Customer Logout - 1
acceptance_criteria.description: The system shall allow a customer to log out.
acceptance_criteria.acceptance_condition: The system shall demonstrate: The system shall allow a customer to log out.

acceptance_criteria.title: Acceptance for Customer Logout - 2
acceptance_criteria.description: Logout shall terminate the customer session.
acceptance_criteria.acceptance_condition: The system shall demonstrate: Logout shall terminate the customer session.

acceptance_criteria.title: Acceptance for Customer Transfers Simulated Money - 1
acceptance_criteria.description: The system shall allow a customer to initiate a transfer of simulated money.
acceptance_criteria.acceptance_condition: The system shall demonstrate: The system shall allow a customer to initiate a transfer of simulated money.

acceptance_criteria.title: Acceptance for Customer Transfers Simulated Money - 2
acceptance_criteria.description: Money movement is simulated using synthetic data; no real money moves.
acceptance_criteria.acceptance_condition: The system shall demonstrate: Money movement is simulated using synthetic data; no real money moves.

acceptance_criteria.title: Acceptance for Customer Receives Simulated Money - 1
acceptance_criteria.description: The system shall allow a customer to receive simulated money.
acceptance_criteria.acceptance_condition: The system shall demonstrate: The system shall allow a customer to receive simulated money.

acceptance_criteria.title: Acceptance for Customer Receives Simulated Money - 2
acceptance_criteria.description: Money movement is simulated using synthetic data; no real money moves.
acceptance_criteria.acceptance_condition: The system shall demonstrate: Money movement is simulated using synthetic data; no real money moves.

acceptance_criteria.title: Acceptance for Customer Views Statements - 1
acceptance_criteria.description: The system shall allow a customer to view statements.
acceptance_criteria.acceptance_condition: The system shall demonstrate: The system shall allow a customer to view statements.

acceptance_criteria.title: Acceptance for Customer Downloads Statements - 1
acceptance_criteria.description: The system shall allow a customer to download statements.
acceptance_criteria.acceptance_condition: The system shall demonstrate: The system shall allow a customer to download statements.

acceptance_criteria.title: Acceptance for Bank Operations Reviews KYC - 1
acceptance_criteria.description: The system shall allow bank operations to review KYC information.
acceptance_criteria.acceptance_condition: The system shall demonstrate: The system shall allow bank operations to review KYC information.

acceptance_criteria.title: Acceptance for Bank Operations Sets KYC Status - 1
acceptance_criteria.description: The system shall allow bank operations to set the KYC status of a customer.
acceptance_criteria.acceptance_condition: The system shall demonstrate: The system shall allow bank operations to set the KYC status of a customer.

acceptance_criteria.title: Acceptance for Bank Operations Activates Customer Accounts - 1
acceptance_criteria.description: The system shall allow bank operations to activate a customer account.
acceptance_criteria.acceptance_condition: The system shall demonstrate: The system shall allow bank operations to activate a customer account.

acceptance_criteria.title: Acceptance for Bank Operations Freezes Customer Accounts - 1
acceptance_criteria.description: The system shall allow bank operations to freeze a customer account.
acceptance_criteria.acceptance_condition: The system shall demonstrate: The system shall allow bank operations to freeze a customer account.

acceptance_criteria.title: Acceptance for Bank Operations Freezes Customer Accounts - 2
acceptance_criteria.description: A frozen account shall reflect the frozen state.
acceptance_criteria.acceptance_condition: The system shall demonstrate: A frozen account shall reflect the frozen state.

acceptance_criteria.title: Acceptance for Bank Operations Views Customer Account State - 1
acceptance_criteria.description: The system shall allow bank operations to view the state of a customer account.
acceptance_criteria.acceptance_condition: The system shall demonstrate: The system shall allow bank operations to view the state of a customer account.

acceptance_criteria.title: Acceptance for Bank Operations Accesses the Audit Trail - 1
acceptance_criteria.description: The system shall allow bank operations to access the audit trail.
acceptance_criteria.acceptance_condition: The system shall demonstrate: The system shall allow bank operations to access the audit trail.

acceptance_criteria.title: Acceptance for Bank Operations Login - 1
acceptance_criteria.description: The system shall allow bank operations to log in.
acceptance_criteria.acceptance_condition: The system shall demonstrate: The system shall allow bank operations to log in.

acceptance_criteria.title: Acceptance for Bank Operations Login - 2
acceptance_criteria.description: Login shall provide bank operations access consistent with role-based access requirements (see FR-019).
acceptance_criteria.acceptance_condition: The system shall demonstrate: Login shall provide bank operations access consistent with role-based access requirements (see FR-019).

acceptance_criteria.title: Acceptance for Bank Operations Logout - 1
acceptance_criteria.description: The system shall allow bank operations to log out.
acceptance_criteria.acceptance_condition: The system shall demonstrate: The system shall allow bank operations to log out.

acceptance_criteria.title: Acceptance for Bank Operations Logout - 2
acceptance_criteria.description: Logout shall terminate the bank-operations session.
acceptance_criteria.acceptance_condition: The system shall demonstrate: Logout shall terminate the bank-operations session.

acceptance_criteria.title: Acceptance for Role-Based Access - 1
acceptance_criteria.description: The system shall keep customer and bank-operations journeys distinct through role-based access.
acceptance_criteria.acceptance_condition: The system shall demonstrate: The system shall keep customer and bank-operations journeys distinct through role-based access.

acceptance_criteria.title: Acceptance for Role-Based Access - 2
acceptance_criteria.description: Actions available to a user shall be consistent with the user's role.
acceptance_criteria.acceptance_condition: The system shall demonstrate: Actions available to a user shall be consistent with the user's role.

acceptance_criteria.title: Acceptance for Auditable State Changes - 1
acceptance_criteria.description: The system shall record state changes so that they are auditable.
acceptance_criteria.acceptance_condition: The system shall demonstrate: The system shall record state changes so that they are auditable.

acceptance_criteria.title: Acceptance for Synthetic Data Simulation - 1
acceptance_criteria.description: The system shall use synthetic identities, accounts, balances, beneficiaries, and payments.
acceptance_criteria.acceptance_condition: The system shall demonstrate: The system shall use synthetic identities, accounts, balances, beneficiaries, and payments.

acceptance_criteria.title: Acceptance for Synthetic Data Simulation - 2
acceptance_criteria.description: The system shall not use real money, real identity verification, or real banking integration.
acceptance_criteria.acceptance_condition: The system shall demonstrate: The system shall not use real money, real identity verification, or real banking integration.

acceptance_criteria.title: Acceptance for Agent Artifact Quality - 1
acceptance_criteria.description: Agent-produced artifacts shall be reviewable, reproducible, schema-valid, source-linked, and subject to human approval.
acceptance_criteria.acceptance_condition: The system shall demonstrate: Agent-produced artifacts shall be reviewable, reproducible, schema-valid, source-linked, and subject to human approval.

acceptance_criteria.title: Acceptance for Requirements Traceability - 1
acceptance_criteria.description: Approved business rules shall remain traceable through requirements, design, implementation, test, defect decision, and final evidence record.
acceptance_criteria.acceptance_condition: The system shall demonstrate: Approved business rules shall remain traceable through requirements, design, implementation, test, defect decision, and final evidence record.
